combo1.title: Skyfall Shield: Ash-Proof Raviel Opener (Effect 1)
combo1.description: Going first. Starting hand: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms, Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder and Sacred Beasts Skyfall. Your opponent chains Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring to Raviel's reveal effect, and Skyfall's first effect negates it. The line ends on Infinity Raviel with Martyrs to Tribute for its board wipe on your opponent's turn, plus the 2 cards Fallen Paradise draws.

cards.name: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts

steps.text: Activate effect: reveal Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms in your hand. It adds 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand, then you discard 1 card.

Your opponent chains Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring. Chain Sacred Beasts Skyfall from your hand as Chain Link 3 and choose its first effect: they activated a card in response to your "Sacred Beast" monster's effect. A Quick-Play Spell can be activated from the hand during your own turn.
Skyfall resolves first and negates Ash Blossom's effect. Ash Blossom is still in their GY with its once-per-turn used, so it can't come back for Martyr later. Skyfall goes to the GY.
Raviel's effect resolves: add Martyr of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck to your hand.

Then discard 1 card: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon. Keep Raviel, because Thunderclap needs a Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand to reveal. With Hamon in the GY, Martyr's End Phase effect is live too.
Normal Summon Martyr of the Sacred Beasts.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts was Normal Summoned. Place 1 "Sacred Beast" Continuous Spell from your Deck face-up on your field.
Sacred Beasts Thunderclap is placed face-up from your Deck. Placing a card doesn't add, summon or send it, so Ash Blossom couldn't have stopped this step anyway.
Activate effect: Sacred Beasts Thunderclap (your Main Phase). Place 2 more copies from your Deck face-up on your field.
The second Thunderclap is placed face-up.
The third Thunderclap is placed face-up.
Then reveal Infinity Raviel in your hand and place Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts (1st of up to 3 uses this turn). Send 3 other cards of the same type from your field to the GY: the three Thunderclaps.
Send the first Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the second Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the third Thunderclap to the GY. During your opponent's End Phase, one Thunderclap in your GY can add itself to your hand.

Then Special Summon Infinity Raviel from your hand in Attack Position. Fallen Paradise is a "Sacred Beast" card, so Raviel's summoning condition is met, and Raviel is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise. You control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10, so draw 2 cards.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts. You control another "Sacred Beast" monster (Raviel), so Special Summon 2 Martyrs from your Deck. Ash Blossom was already used this turn.
Special Summon the second Martyr from your Deck.
Special Summon the third Martyr from your Deck.

End board: Infinity Raviel (4000 ATK) and three Martyrs under Fallen Paradise. On your opponent's turn, Raviel's Quick Effect Tributes 2 Martyrs (they are "Sacred Beast" monsters) to destroy every monster they control, and gains 1000 ATK for each one. In their End Phase, 1 Martyr returns to your hand because Calamity Hamon is in your GY.

combo2.title: Skyfall to Illusion Gate: Going-Second OTK (Effect 2)
combo2.description: Going second into a board of monsters. Starting hand: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts, Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder and Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms. Calamity Hamon adds Skyfall, Skyfall adds Illusion Gate, and Fallen Paradise brings out Hamon and Raviel in Attack Position. Illusion Gate destroys their monsters, Hamon deals 1000 damage, and two 4000 ATK direct attacks finish the Duel.

cards.name: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts

steps.text: Normal Summon Martyr of the Sacred Beasts.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts was Normal Summoned. Place 1 "Sacred Beast" Continuous Spell from your Deck face-up on your field.
Sacred Beasts Thunderclap is placed face-up from your Deck.
Activate effect: Sacred Beasts Thunderclap (your Main Phase). Place 2 more copies from your Deck face-up on your field.
The second Thunderclap is placed face-up.
The third Thunderclap is placed face-up.
Then reveal Calamity Hamon in your hand and place Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
Activate effect: reveal Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder in your hand. It adds 1 "Sacred Beast" Spell from your Deck to your hand, then you discard 1 card.
Add Sacred Beasts Skyfall from your Deck to your hand. Calamity Hamon is the only "Sacred Beast" card that adds Skyfall from the Deck.
Then discard 1 card: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel. Fallen Paradise can Special Summon it from the GY later.
Activate Sacred Beasts Skyfall and choose its second effect, revealing Calamity Hamon as the Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand.
Skyfall resolves: discard 1 card. Discard Calamity Hamon itself; it only had to be revealed to activate the effect.
Add Illusion Gate from your Deck to your hand.
Sacred Beasts Skyfall goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts (1st of up to 3 uses this turn). Send the three Thunderclaps from your field to the GY.
Send the first Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the second Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the third Thunderclap to the GY.
Then Special Summon Calamity Hamon from your GY in Attack Position. It is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise. You control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10, so draw 2 cards.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts. You control another "Sacred Beast" monster (Calamity Hamon), so Special Summon 2 Martyrs from your Deck.
Special Summon the second Martyr from your Deck.
Special Summon the third Martyr from your Deck.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise (2nd use). Send the three Martyrs from your field to the GY.
Send the first Martyr to the GY.
Send the second Martyr to the GY.
Send the third Martyr to the GY.
Then Special Summon Infinity Raviel from your GY in Attack Position.
Activate Illusion Gate (Normal Spell). Pay half your LP (8000 to 4000). Hamon and Raviel are already out, so Hamon's damage effect can trigger.

Illusion Gate resolves: destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible. Then you can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions. That part applies once per Duel.
Illusion Gate goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Calamity Hamon. Monsters were sent to your opponent's GY, so inflict 1000 damage (8000 to 7000).
Battle Phase: Calamity Hamon and Infinity Raviel attack directly for 4000 each, 8000 in total against the 7000 your opponent has left. The monster you took from their GY can attack for extra damage.

combo3.title: Abyss into Skyfall: Two Interruptions from Two Cards (Effect 3)
combo3.description: Going first. Starting hand: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts and Sacred Beasts Skyfall. Martyr places Abyss of the Sacred Beasts, Abyss places two more, and Skyfall is Set. On your opponent's turn, the three Abyss turn their monster face-down, then Skyfall shuffles those three Traps back into the Deck to destroy a second card.

steps.text: Normal Summon Martyr of the Sacred Beasts.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts was Normal Summoned. This time place a "Sacred Beast" Continuous Trap from your Deck face-up on your field.
Abyss of the Sacred Beasts is placed face-up from your Deck.
Activate effect: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts (during the Main Phase). Place 2 more copies from your Deck face-up on your field.
The second Abyss is placed face-up.
The third Abyss is placed face-up.
Set Sacred Beasts Skyfall. A Set Quick-Play Spell can't be activated the turn it was Set, so it becomes live on your opponent's turn. End your turn.
Your opponent's turn: they Special Summon their main monster. Activate effect: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts. Send 3 face-up Abyss you control to the GY, then target that monster.
Send the first Abyss to the GY.
Send the second Abyss to the GY.
Send the third Abyss to the GY. The effect resolves: the targeted monster changes to face-down Defense Position, so its effects on the field are gone.
Flip up your Set Sacred Beasts Skyfall and choose its third effect: shuffle 3 "Sacred Beast" Traps from your GY into the Deck.
Shuffle the first Abyss into your Deck.
Shuffle the second Abyss into your Deck.
Shuffle the third Abyss into your Deck, then target 1 card your opponent controls, such as their next monster, a Field Spell or a Set card.
Skyfall resolves: destroy the target, and Skyfall goes to the GY. All three Abyss are back in your Deck, so Martyr can place them again next turn.
